newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian bonds outpaced in bloc bar N.Z.
newsitem.headline: Australian bonds outpaced in bloc bar N.Z.

text.p: Australian bonds were outpaced within the dollar bloc with the exception of New Zealand debt which weakened with the N.Z. dollar.
Supply factors undermined the local market ahead of Tuesday's A$900 million two-tranche bond tender, combined with a 3.3 percent rise in ANZ's job ads series for January.
The Australian labour force report is due on Thursday.

Early weakness in U.S. Treasuries in Tokyo trading after the U.S. dollar fell sharply following this weekend's G7 meeting added to the local down trend and saw yield spreads widen, particularly against Canada.
The Canadian market rallied on Friday after its labour market report showed unemployment remaining at 9.7 percent and employment rising just 5,100.

The New Zealand market took its lead from an initial fall in the N.Z. TWI and saw the Australian/N.Z. 10-year bond yield spread retreat to parity after New Zealand held a small discount in the past few week's.
